pages.title: Operation
pages.text: The Redstone Clock starts pulsing when placed. It stays off for 18 ticks, then emits signal strength 15 for 2 ticks.$(br2)At the normal tick rate, that produces one pulse each second. It does not need a power cable.

pages.title: Circuit connection
pages.text: Connect it to an input pin of a sequential circuit mounted in a $(l:siliconic:wafer_guard)wafer guard$(/l) to test latches and flip-flops.$(br2)Check that repeated pulses produce the intended result, and inspect wire attenuation and gate direction.
